en: Left the City of Stayvesant.
zh: 离开了逗留城。

en: Adventure Succeeded.\n60 days well spent.
zh: 冒险圆满结束了。\n度过了有收获的60天。

en: An exciting adventure begins.
zh: 激动人心的冒险开始了。

en: Feeling confident with ample supplies.
zh: 因为充足的物资感到信心满满。

en: Everything is going smoothly so far.
zh: 目前一切进展顺利。

en: Casually solved a roadside puzzle.
zh: 随手解开了路边的谜题。

en: Noticed a hidden shortcut.
zh: 留意到一处隐蔽的捷径。

en: Backpack management succeeded.
zh: 背包管理成功。

en: Recalled a thought from before departure.
zh: 回忆起了出发前的某个念头。

en: Added a new marker to the map.
zh: ​在​地图​上​添​加​了​新​的​标记。

en: Found treasure at a shiny under the tree.
zh: 在树下的光点获得了宝贝。

en: Discovered a hidden hot spring.
zh: 发现了隐藏的温泉。

en: Learned a new skill.
zh: 领悟了新的技能。

en: Bargained well with a traveling merchant.
zh: 在旅行商人手上淘到了便宜货。

en: Found a handy stick.
zh: 找到了一根趁手的木棍。

en: A day of pleasant mood.
zh: 心情舒畅的一天。

en: Broke a personal record on stone skipping.
zh: 打水漂破了个人纪录。

en: Skillfully built a campfire with sticks and stones.
zh: 娴熟地用树枝和石头搭建了火堆。

en: Used a lockpick to open a chest and found another lockpick inside.
zh: 用​撬锁器​打开​了​箱子，​发现​了​撬锁器。

en: Found a map left by predecessors.
zh: 找到了前人留下的地图。

en: Discovered an excellent campsite.
zh: 发现了一处得天独厚的扎营点。

en: Passed a fruit tree, ate, and stocked up.
zh: 路过一棵果树，连吃带拿。

en: Discovered a gorgeous view.
zh: 发现一处绝景。

en: Harvested honey while the bees were away.
zh: 趁蜂群外出，采集到了蜂蜜。

en: Found extra supplies in a backpack corner.
zh: 在背包的角落里翻出额外的物资。

en: Climbed a watchtower, surveyed the surroundings.
zh: 登上了一座瞭望塔，掌握了周边信息。

en: Caught the largest fish in the lake.
zh: 钓上​了​湖里​最​大​的​鱼。

en: Tonight's grilled fish was perfectly cooked.
zh: 今晚的鱼烤得外酥里嫩，恰到好处。

en: With plenty of supplies left, indulged in a lavish dinner.
zh: 还剩很多物资，晚餐奢侈了一把。

en: Enjoyed a refreshing bath in the lake.
zh: 在湖里洗了个痛快澡。

en: Quickly repaired worn shoes.
zh: 三下五除二补好了磨损的鞋。

en: Rations spoiled just right, adding a special flavor.
zh: 干粮肉变质得恰到好处，别有风味。

en: Looked back on the journey and felt growth.
zh: 回顾来时路，感受到了成长。

en: Jumped from a great height unscathed.
zh: 从很高的地方跳下来，毫发无伤。

en: A small boat happened to be moored by the broken bridge.
zh: 断桥旁刚好停着一尾小船。

en: Brought down a bird's nest with just one stone.
zh: 只用一发石头就击落了鸟窝。

en: Experienced the legendary runner's high.
zh: 体会到了传说中的跑步高潮。

en: The lake water was cooling under the blazing sun.
zh: 烈日下的湖水透心凉。

en: Ducked into a cave a second before the rain fell.
zh: 在雨点落下的前一秒躲进了一个洞穴。

en: Stayed overnight in a deserted house.
zh: 在无人的房屋里借宿了一宿。

en: At the end of the road, found a stone smooth as a chair, very comfortable.
zh: 长路的尽头发现一块平整如椅的石头，很舒适。

en: Climbed an impossible-looking cliff.
zh: 爬上了看似不可能的峭壁。

en: Cleverly avoided a troublesome area.
zh: 巧妙地规避了麻烦的区域。

en: Wasn't fooled by road signs, stayed true to the path.
zh: 没有上路牌的当，坚定了内心的道路。

en: Made perfect use of an obscure survival skill.
zh: 完美用上了一个很冷门的生存技巧。

en: Adventure failed. \nMight as well have stayed in the city for a little longer...
zh: 冒险失败了。\n要是在城里多逗留一下的话…

en: A supposed shortcut led to a dead end.
zh: 一条看似捷径的路没能走通。

en: A carefully built camp was destroyed.
zh: 精心搭建的营地被摧毁了。

en: It rained all night, couldn’t sleep well.
zh: 雨下整夜，没有睡好。

en: Overestimated jumping ability, landed in mud.
zh: 高估了自己的跳跃能力，在小河沟摔得一身淤泥。

en: Sat by the river all day, bait all eaten.
zh: 在河边坐了一整天，鱼饵都被吃完了。

en: A day of constant misfortune.
zh: 诸事不顺的一天。

en: Steps grew lighter—turns out the backpack had a hole.
zh: 脚步愈发轻快，原来是背包破了洞。

en: Conquered the hill, only to realize it was the wrong one.
zh: 征服了眼前的山丘，到顶才发现爬错了。

en: Adventure Score
zh: 冒险得分

en: Final Score
zh: 最终得分

zh: 感谢测试！\n为了更好地帮助我们设计，如您同意，请点击下方按钮导出游戏日志到您的剪贴板，并通过微信发送给我们。再次感谢！
